title: Level 12: Fighter (Battle Master), Bard (Lore), Wizard (Evocation), Rogue (Thief); each its hireling's race and background
draft: the Fighter's third manoeuvre is Sweeping Attack in place of Goading Attack, whose Goaded status hands the target's turn to the game's AI (owner, 2026-11-08: the game AI doesn't play in the arena); its reference is read again and S4 passes before this file is rated again

builds.role: frontline: heavy armour, a longsword two-handed, Battle Master maneuvers
healer: College of Lore, rapier and hand crossbow

accepted.why: Ruled by the orchestrator (D148). DifficultyCheck.WeaponActionDC reads 8 on a twin and 4 on this build's hireling, but nothing a fight uses follows it: Launch 5b (website ops/logs/live.md, 2026-11-06) read Pommel Strike's DC 15 = ManeuverSaveDC()+2 with the field at 8, no pak file reads the field, and both twins of a pair read the same. Row from L12's S4 (live.md 'L12 launches 2c-4').

Ruled by the orchestrator (D148). Row from L12's S4 (live.md 'L12 launches 2c-4').

Ruled by the orchestrator (D152, D134 of the 4v4 log for the upcast rows). The hireling learned 11 spells it hasn't prepared, with their upcast rows, Fire Shield's variants and their upcasts among them; a twin holds its prepared picks only, which is what a Wizard can cast in an arena: it can't re-prepare in a fight and no rest happens. Read 5 at L5 (website ops/logs/live.md, 'Unlock probe and owed scratch reads', 2026-11-07): the twin refuses Witch Bolt, a spell outside its picks. Rows from L12's S4.

Ruled by the orchestrator (D152). The same rows as `spells`, and a twin's book rows are AlwaysPrepared where a Wizard's are RequiresPreparation, with the same ability, DC and attack; a twin can't change what it holds in a fight. Rows from L12's S4.

Ruled by the orchestrator (D183, D140 of the 4v4 log). Arcane Recovery's upcast rows: a class row gives a twin the spell, so the kit adds these by AddSpell, and an AddSpell'd row reads in `prepared`. It's a class resource spell with nothing to prepare, and the reference holds these rows in `spells`. Rows from L12's S4.
